text:
Maya (marketing): Quick thread — need final decisions on the latency vs cost narrative, 2 chart cuts, and how webinar signups get routed. Goal: landing pages + one slide for the webinar. Deadline: EOD Thursday.

Owen (growth): High-level ask — lead with predictable unit cost. competitors show best-case latency; we should show predictable 95th pct latency + $/1k tokens so buyers can model costs. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Priya (product): Agreed. Suggest two visuals: 1) scatterplot: median latency (ms) on x vs $/1k tokens on y, points sized by max throughput. 2) stacked bar for tail latency (p50/p95/p99) across model variants. Callout copy: "Predictable latency, predictable spend."

Luca (design): I did a quick Figma mock, sharing: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/latcost-mock. Lean, two-color palette, and a small explainer tooltip for how we measure $/1k (inbound request + decode tokens). Will iterate once copy is locked.

Maya (marketing): For webinar slide — can we include a one-liner and a single takeaway metric? Maybe: "X% lower unit cost at 95th pct latency vs open-hosted alternative". Need to avoid naming competitors directly.

Priya (product): One-liner idea: "Same or lower latency at a fraction of the unit cost — predictable inference economics for production." Metric to show: delta in $/1k for a representative 2k-token chat workload + 95th pct latency. We have the numbers from the perf team: median cost 0.82, competitor 1.9, p95 latency 180ms vs 420ms. I'll confirm and paste raw numbers.

Owen (growth): For copy tests: A/B these headlines in the ad/webinar CTA — A: "Cut inference spend without trading latency" B: "Maintain latency SLAs while halving per-token cost" — run to 10k impressions.

Luca (design): Small UX ask — add a micro-legend explaining traffic profile (burst vs steady) because batching changes economics. Otherwise people will misinterpret.

Maya (marketing): Routing plan for webinar signups: we want high-intent demo requests to go to AE queue; everyone else gets a 3-email nurture + product doc. Proposed fields on form: company_size, intent (demo/pilot/learn), annual_infra_budget (opt).

Priya (product): Here's a minimal routing rule snippet we can implement in the form handler:```yaml
rules:
  - if: company_size >= 1000 or intent == "demo" or annual_infra_budget >= 250000
    route: "AE-enterprise"
  - if: intent == "pilot" and company_size >= 50
    route: "solutions"
  - else:
    route: "nurture-drip"
```

Owen (growth): OK — add a lead score weight for webinar engagement (attended + asked question) so we can bump MQLs post-event. Also tag source = webinar-2026-03-xx.

BenchBot (bot): perf-report uploaded: https://storage.internal/redwood/perf/1795549998-latcost-run.csv :robot_face:

Maya (marketing): Great — next steps: Priya, confirm the p95/p50 numbers by EOD Wed; Luca, update figma with micro-legend and the two chart cuts; Owen, set up the A/B headline test and draft routing tags; I'll draft the webinar slide + two short social posts once copy is confirmed. :thumbsup:

Owen (growth): On it.

Priya (product): Will confirm numbers.

Luca (design): Updating now.

Maya (marketing): Thanks all — will sync again in #marketing standup tomorrow.
